create_TFNormalizer: create a TFNormalizer instance with a TensorFlow session, scope, and observation size for DeepMimic learning
normalize_tf_tensor: normalize a TensorFlow tensor using the TFNormalizer mean and standard deviation variables with clipping
unnormalize_tf_tensor: unnormalize a TensorFlow tensor back to original scale using the TFNormalizer mean and std variables
load_TFNormalizer_state: load saved TFNormalizer state from TensorFlow variables to initialize count, mean, and std values
update_TFNormalizer: update the TFNormalizer TensorFlow variables with new running mean and standard deviation statistics
